generation.scope: All reflected-collision quotient fibers are classified. Outside c squared equal to one there are five or three orbits, with periods at most two. At c squared equal to one the entire fiber is the sixteen half-plane coordinate charts of eight dimensions on sixteen weight lines, up to an explicit torus and finite monomial group. All exceptional charts lie in the fifteen-parameter component, with exact isomorphism, orbit closure, period two or four and six-dimensional maximal families.

open_mathematics: Resolve the no-flip semisimple Bell line fibers including its order-four point. Establish good reduction criteria and continue the general stable and branched coverage.
